## About
Century Tire & Auto Service is a family owned and operated shop on S. Kingshighway Blvd, right at the entrance to The Hill. Our job is honest, accurate repairs and helping keep your car reliable.
Our technicians are knowledgeable and ASE certified, and we stay committed to technical training, testing and certifications. We invest in modern tools and diagnostic scanners, and we keep technical repair information on hand.
We believe in hospitality and want every visit to be a positive repair experience. Neighbors have rated us 4.8 from 166 Google reviews.

## Services
- Oil Change Service: Synthetic Blend, Full Synthetic and High Mileage oils with Valvoline filters. Every oil change includes a 12 point inspection, a top off of fluids and adjusted tire pressures.
- Automatic Transmission service: We remove the pan, replace the internal filter if equipped, top off the fluid and test drive. Designed for regular maintenance.
- Automatic Transmission Flush: Hooks into the cooler lines to replace 100% of the fluid. Pair it with the transmission service to start with clean fluid and a new filter.
- Cooling system service: Fresh coolant plus an inspection of the whole cooling system to see if hoses or other parts need replacing.
- Timing belt replacement: A broken timing belt can do serious engine damage. We recommend replacing the belt with the necessary tensioners, drive pulley and water pump when applicable.
- Brakes: We start with a complete inspection of the braking system so we know what your car really needs. We repair all braking systems, including anti-lock brakes.
- Engine diagnostics: Running rough, won't start, or a check engine light on? We read what your car's computer reports, then verify the failed part before recommending repairs.
- Tire replacement: Through the Independent Tire Dealer Buyers Group we can get all makes of tires at competitive prices, with free flat repairs and rotations on all tires sold.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Thursday 8:00 AM to 4:45 PM, Friday 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How often should I change my oil?
A: We suggest every 3000 miles or 3 months, whichever comes first. Some vehicles have a monitoring program that tells you when.

Q: Can I get an emissions inspection?
A: Yes. We're a member of the Gateway Clean Air Program, and one customer got in for an emissions inspection the morning after calling.

Q: How much will my brake job cost?
A: Every car needs different parts, so we inspect the whole braking system first. Schedule an appointment and we'll tell you what it really needs.

Q: What batteries do you carry?
A: We keep a full line of Interstate brand batteries in stock and can test your battery and charging system.
